query:
SELECT 
  poi.id,
  poi.productId,
  p.name,
  poi.quantity,
  poi.unitCost
FROM purchaseOrderItems poi
JOIN products p ON poi.productId = p.id
WHERE poi.purchaseOrderId = (
  SELECT id FROM purchaseOrders WHERE docNumber = '71875'
)
